_comment: Standalone weekly IcM incident-activity summary (no iris). Auth is plain `az`. Rows are grouped into a Category column. By default Category = the team's display name (from teamDisplayNames below); the categoryKql snippet can override that for teams that need finer splits by a custom field. Counts are fixed (New/Resolved/Mitigated + a Transferred-Out total).
categoryKql: | extend Category = case(TeamLeaf == 'ServiceBlueprint' and cf_45266 == 'Execution Plan', 'Execution Plan', TeamLeaf == 'OnDemandQuota' and cf_45272 == 'OnDemandQuota Ev2 extension', 'On Demand Quota (Ev2)', TeamDisplay)
_howToClassify: Two knobs. (1) teamDisplayNames: a { TeamLeaf -> display name } map. These are the IcM team display names (from the IcM team record, e.g. Whitelist&Quota -> 'Region Access & Quota', SubscriptionWhitelisting -> 'CIS RPs'), NOT the backslashed OwningTeamName. Default Category = the team's display name; unmapped teams fall back to their raw leaf. Edit to rename, or merge two teams into one category by mapping both leaves to the same name. (2) categoryKql (optional): a KQL '| extend Category = ...' snippet for teams that need a finer split by a custom field; end its case() with TeamDisplay so unsplit teams keep their display name. If categoryKql is omitted, Category is just TeamDisplay. Available inputs: TeamLeaf, TeamDisplay, OwningTeamName, Severity, Status, IncidentType, MonitorId, IsNew/IsResolved/IsMitigated/IsTransferred, cf_<id> for each id in customFieldIds. To classify by a DIFFERENT cf, add its id to customFieldIds and branch on cf_<id>. To refresh display names: they come from IcM's team record (iris icm.teamsById, or the GetOnCallScheduleForTeams TeamName field).
_cfVocab: Seen values — cf 45266: Blueprint, Execution Plan, Fulfillment. cf 45272: Other request related, Creating Request on Lionrock Portal, OnDemandQuota Ev2 extension. cf 45269 (RPName): Subscription, PlannedQuota, PreApprovedQuota. Most teams set no cf and map by team alone.
_auth: Run `az login` as a user with IcM Kusto warehouse read access. The warehouse (icmcluster.kusto.windows.net) accepts the signed-in user's token; no cert, no iris.
